assessment.summary: Worker completion is not reliable because WaitGroup registration occurs after goroutine launch and can race with Wait.

findings.title: WaitGroup registration races with the wait lifecycle

evidence.message: workers.Add runs inside the goroutine it is intended to register.

findings.recommendation: Call Add in the launching goroutine before each go statement, then defer Done as the first operation inside the worker.

opinion.summary: I would move worker registration into the launching goroutine before merging.
